content: Both ligands are jnk3-inactive and both are poor hosts, so crossover buys nothing. Working on ligand 1. Its worst feature is the protonated piperazine at atoms 12-17: the [NH2+] is what drags QED to 0.63 and LogP to -1.70, and it is an entirely aliphatic, fully saturated tail with no aromatic character at all (num_aromatic_rings=0). The bond 11-12 joins the azetidine C3 to the piperazine N and is not a ring bond, so I can cut it and graft in its place. I am installing 1H-indazol-5-yl - an indazole hinge binder, which is one of the most common cores in JNK inhibitor series and is cheap synthetically. This removes the charge, adds the first aromatic ring to the molecule, and should move QED up sharply while keeping MW around 335.
